acceptedFindings.basis: The frozen card teaches separating into parts (snapshot/kanji/析.md:23). This is independently supported by the character-level Daijisen definition こまかく分かつ (evidence/external-snapshots/01-extract.txt:7) and KANJIDIC2 divide (evidence/kanjidic2-records.xml:52), without treating a whole-word JMdict gloss as a general character meaning. 別 and 離 both display separate, and neither direct pair is declared on either endpoint. Existing 析/分 and 分/離 declarations do not cover 析/離. The content contract requires checking displayed labels against ordinary meanings and explicitly makes exclusions non-transitive (repo/docs/content-format.md:97-114).
acceptedFindings.fix: Append 別 and 離 to 析's quiz_exclusions while preserving all original exclusions, and explain the direct separation overlap concisely in Notes. Do not remove the source-supported dividing sense merely to suppress the collision.
acceptedFindings.scope: A bounded semantic safeguard. Current curated choices already fill all slots; this does not claim a demonstrated collision in the current default pool or native/arbitrary-pool acceptance.

acceptanceLimit: Bounded independent evidence, not publication approval. Accepted findings require signed fixes and confirmation; the raw report is unchanged.
